name: MCCS Camp Pendleton
localContext: Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton is on the Southern California coast in northern San Diego County, between Oceanside and San Clemente. Visitors include active-duty Marines and Sailors, their families, retirees, DoD civilians, and guests.
welcomeMessage: Hi! I can help you find facilities, hours, programs, and events at MCCS Camp Pendleton. What are you looking for?
